# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.

  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.

  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.

  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]

  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.

  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]
[Chabot graphic]
[Healthcare Insights][63]

### Dr. Chatbot Will See You Now

What role will AI play in healthcare in the future? We believe there are realistic opportunities for
AI to make healthcare more efficient and effective

[Read More][64]
[ Press Release ][65]

### Baxter Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report Highlighting Refreshed Strategy, Ongoing Commitment
### to Drive Meaningful Impact

[Read More][66]
[ Press Release ][67]

### Baxter Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results

[Read More][68]
[ Press Release ][69]

### Baxter Showcases Recent Innovations at AORN Global Surgical Conference and Expo 2026

[Read More][70]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

[Man holding a surfing board smiling with a ocean in the background.]

# Welcome to Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.

**“For The Healthier Humankind”**

The definition of Actiza is “**Active zeal**”. We have an active zeal for a healthier world. Actiza
Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. has become a paradigm in pharmaceutical manufacturing, exporting, and
supplying products that meet international standards. Actiza believes in a systematic approach to
all its endeavours. Hence, we have **WHO, GMP, and ISO accreditations** for our business. India has
been a hub for medical tourism, and now it has become an epicentre for pharmaceutical manufacturing,
alongside the world’s medicinal exporter and supplier of all medicines to create a world that is
healthier and happier. We are proud to represent India as an Indian pharmaceutical manufacturing
company to the world as a pure exporter with a **corporate office in Surat, Gujarat, India.**

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.

GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

## A story of helping fight diseases better

1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules

  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody

# We enable patients' independence

We are the pioneering leader in designing, developing, and manufacturing self-injection devices such
as autoinjectors.

[ About us ][160] [ Our products ][161]

## Get to know SHL Medical

[
[patient-using-molly-auto-injector]
Why choose us

### Why choose us

By producing the world's best autoinjectors, we empower millions of patients worldwide to be more
independent, 6.5 million to be exact. Our impact is even bigger: we benefit the entire healthcare
system by improving treatment results and reducing healthcare costs.

][162]
[
Our products

### Our products

We believe that people living with chronic conditions should not be defined by their diseases. That
is why we develop advanced drug delivery systems that help enhance self-injection.

][163]
[
[SMART-Autoinjector-Molly-Powerpack-20240516-5]
Our services

### Our services

We provide full end-to-end solutions from device development to distribution, including final
assembly, labeling, and packaging services for our drug delivery devices.

][164]

## Milestones that define us

From breakthrough innovations and manufacturing expansion to strategic partnerships and industry
recognition, our latest milestones demonstrate the momentum behind SHL Medical's continued growth.
Over the past year, we have reinforced our market leadership through world-class manufacturing
capabilities, expanded our global footprint, and embedded sustainability into every aspect of our
business, creating lasting value for customers, patients, and communities worldwide.
[
[[.jpg] 1-5 billion-autoinjectors]
Corporate

### SHL Medical marks global milestone with 1.5 billion autoinjectors shipped

Read More

][165] [
[[.jpg] ecovadis-gold-shl-medical]
Sustainability

### SHL Medical earns EcoVadis Gold Medal

Read More

][166]

## Performance that repeats

Our newest addition to the product portfolio is Quanta, an automatic, multi-fixed-dose pen injector
designed for once-weekly cardiometabolic therapies. Quanta focuses on four key areas central to
long-duration therapy programs: handling experience, dosing performance, cost considerations, and
sustainability alignment. Its no-priming, spring-driven design simplifies the injection process
while supporting consistent dosing. The multi-dose format also helps improve operational efficiency
and reduce material use throughout treatment.
[ Learn more about Quanta ][167]
[[.psd] Quanta 2 devices 2uncap (3 Angles Attached)]

## The latest news and insights

Stay informed about the latest updates from our organization by visiting our News and insights page.
Explore a wide range of content, including announcements about our newest products, key
organizational developments, upcoming events, and in-depth industry insights.

 

You will also find valuable information on upcoming events, thought-provoking blog posts, inspiring
success stories, and a variety of resources available for download. Whether you are seeking the
latest innovations, expert perspectives, or updates on our ongoing efforts, this is your
comprehensive resource for staying connected and informed

[ Discover news ][168] [ Blog ][169]
[SHL-Medical 2024 CPHI-Milan IMG 5547]

## Join us in crafting future healthcare solutions

Every day, our self-injection solutions help millions of patients live more independently. Powered
by an entrepreneurial spirit, we turn challenges into opportunities by listening attentively,
thinking carefully, and acting boldly. With more than 6,000 colleagues from over 60 nationalities,
we thrive on the diversity of perspectives that fuel innovation. Together, we are shaping the future
of drug delivery and advancing our leadership in self-injection technologies.
[ Go to our career page ][170] [ How we work ][171]
[SHL-Medical 2024 Level Up Workshop ZUG-20240808-55]

## Building success responsibly

Sustainability is embedded in how we think, act, and grow. As we expand our reach to more patients
worldwide, we remain committed to reducing our environmental footprint, advancing responsible
business practices, and fostering a safe, diverse, and inclusive workplace.
Through innovation, we empower patient independence while creating lasting value for our customers,
communities, and the planet.

system by improving treatment results and reducing healthcare costs.

][162]
[
Our products

### Our products

We believe that people living with chronic conditions should not be defined by their diseases. That
is why we develop advanced drug delivery systems that help enhance self-injection.

][163]
[

Our services

### Our services

We provide full end-to-end solutions from device development to distribution, including final
assembly, labeling, and packaging services for our drug delivery devices.

][164]

## Milestones that define us

From breakthrough innovations and manufacturing expansion to strategic partnerships and industry
recognition, our latest milestones demonstrate the momentum behind SHL Medical's continued growth.
Over the past year, we have reinforced our market leadership through world-class manufacturing
capabilities, expanded our global footprint, and embedded sustainability into every aspect of our
business, creating lasting value for customers, patients, and communities worldwide.
[

][166]

## Performance that repeats

Our newest addition to the product portfolio is Quanta, an automatic, multi-fixed-dose pen injector
designed for once-weekly cardiometabolic therapies. Quanta focuses on four key areas central to
long-duration therapy programs: handling experience, dosing performance, cost considerations, and
sustainability alignment. Its no-priming, spring-driven design simplifies the injection process
while supporting consistent dosing. The multi-dose format also helps improve operational efficiency
and reduce material use throughout treatment.
[ Learn more about Quanta ][167]

Stay informed about the latest updates from our organization by visiting our News and insights page.

You will also find valuable information on upcoming events, thought-provoking blog posts, inspiring

Every day, our self-injection solutions help millions of patients live more independently. Powered

thinking carefully, and acting boldly. With more than 6,000 colleagues from over 60 nationalities,
we thrive on the diversity of perspectives that fuel innovation. Together, we are shaping the future
of drug delivery and advancing our leadership in self-injection technologies.

gene therapies with the highest standards of quality. Whether you need an end-to-end solution or a

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

  state-of-the-art technologies. With integrated formulation development services, scalable

* Our worldwide presence and deep regulatory expertise enable partners to meet country-specific

Bora currently owns and operates nine cGMP manufacturing facilities – in Taiwan, Canada, and the
United States – built to the highest international standards for pharmaceutical development,
manufacturing, packaging, labeling, and analytical testing.

We manufacture and supply finished drug products to countries in North, Central, and South America,
Europe, Russia, the Middle East, and Asia, as well as Australia and New Zealand.

## We are the UK’s leading organisation for healthcare professionals caring for patients with
## allergy.

#### The British Society for Allergy & Clinical Immunology (BSACI) is the national, professional and
#### academic society which represents the specialty of allergy at all levels. Its aim is to improve
#### the management of allergies and related diseases of the immune system in the United Kingdom,
#### through education, training and research.

## We are the UK’s leading organisation for healthcare professionals caring for patients with
## allergy.

#### The British Society for Allergy & Clinical Immunology (BSACI) is the national, professional and
#### academic society which represents the specialty of allergy at all levels. Its aim is to improve
#### the management of allergies and related diseases of the immune system in the United Kingdom,
#### through education, training and research.

# Christian Brothers Automotive

## Car Maintenance and Repair

When Christian Brothers Automotive opened in 1982, our goal was to change the way our local
communities experience automotive care. We set out to implement a standard of service our guests
could come to rely on no matter where in the country they stepped into one of our locations. Here we
believe auto care should feel personal. That’s why we take a people-first approach to everything we
do, prioritizing transparency, compassion, and excellence.

### What Are the Benefits of Regular Auto Maintenance?

Many car owners view regular maintenance as an unnecessary expense. However, there are several
benefits to keeping your car in good working order. First of all, properly maintained vehicles are
more fuel efficient. This means that you'll save money on gas over the long run.

Additionally, regular maintenance can help to improve your car's performance and reduce wear and
tear on the engine. As a result, your car is likely to have a longer lifespan.

Finally, safety is always important when you're on the road. By ensuring that your car is in good
condition, you can help to reduce the risk of accidents and breakdowns. In summary, there are
several advantages to keeping up with regular maintenance for your vehicle.

**We have more than 310 locations nationwide. Contact us today to find a Christian Brothers
Automotive facility near you!**

[Find Your Local Shop][67]
[Christian Brothers employee working on client's vehicle]

#### Where peace of mind becomes standard.

**From oil changes and brake repairs to engine diagnostics and transmissions, our experienced
technicians deliver standard-setting service, offering you care that goes beyond the car. Because
the person behind the wheel matters just as much as what’s under the hood — and your peace of mind
always comes standard. **

loving our neighbors. In doing so, we prioritize transparency and fairness, and offer reliable and
honest service. From simple tune-ups to intensive diagnostics, repairs, and replacements, our
network of Christian Brothers Automotive professionals is ready to get you back on the road as
quickly and safely as possible.

## Car Maintenance and Repair

When Christian Brothers Automotive opened in 1982, our goal was to change the way our local
communities experience automotive care. We set out to implement a standard of service our guests
could come to rely on no matter where in the country they stepped into one of our locations. Here we
believe auto care should feel personal. That’s why we take a people-first approach to everything we
do, prioritizing transparency, compassion, and excellence.

### What Are the Benefits of Regular Auto Maintenance?

Many car owners view regular maintenance as an unnecessary expense. However, there are several
benefits to keeping your car in good working order. First of all, properly maintained vehicles are
more fuel efficient. This means that you'll save money on gas over the long run.

Additionally, regular maintenance can help to improve your car's performance and reduce wear and
tear on the engine. As a result, your car is likely to have a longer lifespan.

Finally, safety is always important when you're on the road. By ensuring that your car is in good
condition, you can help to reduce the risk of accidents and breakdowns. In summary, there are
several advantages to keeping up with regular maintenance for your vehicle.

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.

### PHARMA

## Our Vision

## Computing Infinity™
## Predicting What Works.
## Beyond AI™

## The Validated Infrastructure for Multi-Combination Therapies — Without Trial & Error. Without
## Animal Testing.

[ Our Partners ][33]

###### The Combinatorial Frontier

## There are nearly **one million known natural compounds** and **over 4,000 FDA-approved drugs.**
## When these compounds are combined across different doses, the number of possible combinations
## grows beyond **the number of atoms in the observable universe.**

## Within these combinations likely exist solutions for disease, longevity, and healthier living.
## However, overwhelming complexity is why traditional drug discovery focuses on single compounds
## using animal testing, leaving most potential solutions unexplored.
## 
## **CytoSolve® changes this.**

###### Why CytoSolve®

## CytoSolve® is a computational systems biology platform that makes it possible to **model,
## compute, and understand biology at scale.** By integrating molecular pathways into unified system
## models, CytoSolve® predicts how compounds interact inside living systems, thereby enabling the
## discovery of **safe and synergistic multi-combination therapeutics and formulations.**

## CytoSolve® serves as a foundational infrastructure for modern biology, supporting discovery,
## intellectual property creation, and commercialization across **human, animal, and plant health.**
## 
## CytoSolve® enables its partners to move beyond trial and error to discover what truly works.

###### A Validated Infrastructure

## The legacy pharmaceutical infrastructure took nearly 150 years to develop. CytoSolve® has spent
## the last 15 years accelerating that timeline through deep collaboration with global leaders in
## research, pharma nutraceuticals, CPG, and agriculture.

## Our infrastructure is built on peer-reviewed science and a robust portfolio of granted patents.
## CytoSolve® discoveries have already moved from simulation to reality, resulting in manufactured
## products and **FDA allowance** for novel multi-drug combinations.

###### Computing the Complexity of Life

## CytoSolve® integrates decentralized mechanistic models into coherent, system-level simulations.
## Unlike "black-box" AI, our platform utilizes validated biological knowledge to compute emergent
## behavior across any living system—quantitatively, causally, and reproducibly. We have transformed
## systems biology from a theoretical pursuit into a high-speed engine for **industrial execution.**

## * **Trillion-Scale Evaluation: ** Rapid in silico screening of compound combinations.
## * **Multi-Species Versatility: ** Modeling complex interactions in human, animal, and plant
##   biology.
## * **Precision De-Risking: ** Reduction of costly experimental trial-and-error.
## * **Regulatory-Ready Insights:** Explainable, mechanistic predictions suitable for rigorous
##   review.

###### Founded in Systems Science

## CytoSolve® was born from a breakthrough in systems biology at MIT. It was founded by **Dr. Shiva
## Ayyadurai, MIT PhD,** whose doctoral research enabled the scalable integration of disparate
## biological models into a single, executable architecture—a capability long considered
## computationally infeasible.

## By moving beyond monolithic programming to a distributed, parallelized framework, Dr. Ayyadurai
## created a way to model the **"system of systems" **that governs life.
## 
## What began as a pioneering academic achievement has evolved over the last 15 years into a
## **production-grade infrastructure** for computational systems biology, providing the mechanistic
## certainty required for the next generation of medicine.

###### The Era of Systems Biology is Here

## Biology has entered an era of combinatorial complexity that traditional tools simply cannot
## navigate. Statistical AI cannot explain the "why" behind biological outcomes, and
## **trial-and-error** cannot scale to meet the demands of modern discovery.

## CytoSolve® provides the missing infrastructure required to compute biological systems safely,
## causally, and at scale. After 15 years of rigorous development and successful private validation,
## we are ready for "prime time." The platform exists. The science is validated. The infrastructure
## is now being opened to the world.

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

## Why Choose DENSO?

It’s simple. The DENSO brand is built on delivering more Quality, Reliability, and Value than any
other manufacturer. Whether supplying the world’s automakers with reliable OE parts or developing
aftermarket replacement parts at or above spec, DENSO’s line of products is built to deliver
superior all-around performance every day. Our First Time Fit® philosophy attracts attention
throughout the automotive world, while our commitment to pushing technology into the future
continually sets us apart around the globe. Read below for more ways DENSO rises above the rest.

## A Spark Plug for Everyone

Utilizing decades of experience developing the world’s leading spark plugs, the DENSO family of
spark plugs is unmatched in longevity, durability, increased power, economy and reliability.
* [Iridium TT®][81] – More power, economy, and endurance with the world’s smallest tip.
* [Platinum TT®][82] – Twin tip platinum design with superior longevity and durability.
* [Iridium Power®][83] – Maximum spark energy from the 0.4mm Iridium center electrode.
* [Iridium Racing®][84] – Reliable ignition even under the harshest racing conditions.
* [Iridium Long Life][85] – Improve longevity with the first automotive plug to use Iridium.
* [Double Platinum][86] – Two Platinum electrodes means added durability.
* [U-Groove][87] – A channeled ground electrode means greater fuel efficiency.

## Aftermarket Parts Built at or Above Spec

The quality of DENSO parts is guaranteed because every component that leaves a DENSO factory has
been designed with precision, manufactured to the strictest OE standards or above, and subjected to
rigorous safety and performance tests. In the end, it all comes down to quality — that’s what the
DENSO name stands for.

## Measure Everything for a First Time Fit

First Time Fit® is a promise that DENSO makes to the aftermarket, by providing products that are OE
grade or better – and fits the first time. We know technicians want to get the job done right the
first time, that’s why each DENSO part is precision-built to exact specifications, so it fits
properly on every make and model covered. The DENSO First Time Fit line of products includes oxygen
sensors, compressors, starters, alternators, fuel pumps, oil and air filters, wipers, and much more.
No component leaves our factories without meeting the strictest standards and rigorous safety and
performance tests. We’re proud to say all DENSO aftermarket products are as good as or better than
original equipment.

## Efficiency, Reliability, and Savings

Over half a century ago DENSO began designing and supplying to OEMs. Since 1972, aftermarket
products created exclusively by DENSO have been available for domestic, European and Asian import
vehicles. Since the beginning, DENSO has consistently provided distributors with products featuring
wide coverage across makes and models, quick and easy installation the first time for technicians,
and product reliability and longevity for consumers. All this translates to more money savings at
all levels, making DENSO a clear choice.

## Ahead of the Curve as Product Innovators

For over 70 years, DENSO has been on the cutting edge of automotive technology by contributing new
products, materials, and designs to the OE and aftermarket industry. From the development of the
fuel pump module for a quality replacement option, direct ignition coils, and the open valve
impeller fuel pump, to DENSO being the first manufacturer to use Platinum and Iridium in spark
plugs, and introducing the unique U-Groove spark plug design, DENSO is continually on the front
lines of product advancement.

## There are Hundreds of Vehicle Models Around the World Built With DENSO

Since 1949, DENSO parts have been the global choice for the top automakers, with hundreds of vehicle
models rolling off the assembly line with DENSO under the hood. There are a lot of choices when it
comes to automotive parts, wouldn’t you want to choose the manufacturer selected by all the biggest
names in the automotive industry?

## A Spark Plug for Everyone

Utilizing decades of experience developing the world’s leading spark plugs, the DENSO family of
spark plugs is unmatched in longevity, durability, increased power, economy and reliability.
* [Iridium TT®][81] – More power, economy, and endurance with the world’s smallest tip.

## Aftermarket Parts Built at or Above Spec

The quality of DENSO parts is guaranteed because every component that leaves a DENSO factory has
been designed with precision, manufactured to the strictest OE standards or above, and subjected to
rigorous safety and performance tests. In the end, it all comes down to quality — that’s what the
DENSO name stands for.

## Measure Everything for a First Time Fit

First Time Fit® is a promise that DENSO makes to the aftermarket, by providing products that are OE
grade or better – and fits the first time. We know technicians want to get the job done right the
first time, that’s why each DENSO part is precision-built to exact specifications, so it fits
properly on every make and model covered. The DENSO First Time Fit line of products includes oxygen
sensors, compressors, starters, alternators, fuel pumps, oil and air filters, wipers, and much more.
No component leaves our factories without meeting the strictest standards and rigorous safety and
performance tests. We’re proud to say all DENSO aftermarket products are as good as or better than
original equipment.

## Efficiency, Reliability, and Savings

Over half a century ago DENSO began designing and supplying to OEMs. Since 1972, aftermarket
products created exclusively by DENSO have been available for domestic, European and Asian import
vehicles. Since the beginning, DENSO has consistently provided distributors with products featuring
wide coverage across makes and models, quick and easy installation the first time for technicians,
and product reliability and longevity for consumers. All this translates to more money savings at
all levels, making DENSO a clear choice.

[Alternator]

## Ahead of the Curve as Product Innovators

For over 70 years, DENSO has been on the cutting edge of automotive technology by contributing new
products, materials, and designs to the OE and aftermarket industry. From the development of the
fuel pump module for a quality replacement option, direct ignition coils, and the open valve
impeller fuel pump, to DENSO being the first manufacturer to use Platinum and Iridium in spark
plugs, and introducing the unique U-Groove spark plug design, DENSO is continually on the front
lines of product advancement.

## There are Hundreds of Vehicle Models Around the World Built With DENSO

Since 1949, DENSO parts have been the global choice for the top automakers, with hundreds of vehicle
models rolling off the assembly line with DENSO under the hood. There are a lot of choices when it
comes to automotive parts, wouldn’t you want to choose the manufacturer selected by all the biggest
names in the automotive industry?

### [2026 Nasal & Inhalation Drug Development & Delivery eBook: Drug Repurposing Creates New Market
### Opportunities][16]

In this exclusive seventh annual nasal and inhalation eBook, Drug Development & Delivery highlights
how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

[Featured Articles][17]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - Outsourcing Formulation Development & Manufacturing: Connecting Your Project
### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier

Our commitment to affordability is unwavering. We leverage long-standing manufacturer partnerships

our promise of compliance, reliability, and consistent quality—helping healthcare providers maintain

#### Commitment to Innovation

By investing in advanced technology, Drugzone streamlines ordering, tracking, and compliance.
Healthcare partners—from specialty clinics to hospital chains—benefit from secure, efficient, and
transparent operations. Our integrated ERP and compliance monitoring systems enhance real-time
visibility, inventory accuracy, and traceability throughout the supply chain.


#### Partner-Centric Approach

Long-term relationships drive our success. Drugzone works closely with hospitals, LTC providers, and
specialty networks—listening to their needs and delivering solutions that help them serve their
patients better. Our dedicated account managers provide personalized support, ensuring every partner
experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our
collaboration.

## Comprehensive Distribution Capabilities

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

### Wholesale& Specialty Distribution

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

### Logistics& Warehousing

State-of-the-art warehouses and a nationwide delivery network ensure secure storage and timely
shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

### Provider& Pharmacy Solutions

Tailored support for diverse healthcare partners and specialty distributors to simplify procurement
and maintain an uninterrupted treatment supply.

### Compliance& Quality Assurance

We ensure full adherence to NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 guidelines. Every shipment undergoes stringent
checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

## Trusted Partnerships, Reliable Supply

Drugzone strengthens its nationwide supply reliability through long-standing partnerships with
leading generic manufacturers. These strategic alliances ensure verified authenticity, stable
pricing, and consistent access to essential medications across multiple therapeutic areas.

## Human & Animal Health

At Drugzone, equal commitment is given to human and animal health, ensuring safe, compliant, and
reliable access to quality pharmaceuticals across the U.S. under NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025
standards.

[img]

## Human Health

Drugzone supports healthcare facilities nationwide with access to safe, cost-effective generic
formulations. Each product is stored and distributed following the strictest compliance standards.

[img]
